information.description:
Certain Patrol Officers have really seen some shit during their service, and are thus appropriately talented at taking down punks. They often work alongside tactical squads or operate in rougher sections of the city, but aren’t as talented at analyzing a crime scene or working the street for leads.

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.

Superior jacketed ammo, a collapsible stock, and gyro-stabilizers are why the M221’s ‘Military’ variant is preferred by PMCs and soldiers over its watered down ‘Civilian’ counterpart. Thankfully, this warfare-ready model isn’t too hard to find, assuming you can spare the extra euro.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).

Unity is often sought after, but difficult to achieve. After all, Night City is a city of individualists, anarchists and warring gangs. To unite under a shared banner, you'll need a persuasive argument – preferably cast from lead. The designers responsible for the Unity understood this well. This universal, inexpensive pistol has resolved countless conflicts and put a stop to disputes. Dissatisfied customers, betrayed spouses, impatient drivers stuck in traffic – chances are they'll pull out a Unity.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) ♦ Required Slots: 0

Fits: All Ranged Weapons

“How d’ya think it works? You take a flashlight, you know that metal stick that ain’t a sex aid, and bolt it on. It ain’t complicated, I promise.”

A barrel-oriented Flashlight with a 1- is installed that can be used without a hand while the weapon is wielded. Runs off easily rechargeable (1 hour) battery packs that last up to 2 hours of continual use. Extra battery packs cost 20eb (Everyday).

This negates the penalty for firing in darkness, night, or low light conditions at targets the flashlight is illuminating (for you and anyone whom can see the flashlight’s projection), but does not negate the penalty from obscurement by smoke, fog, or a similar effect. When the weapon is not currently being wielded, the light automatically turns off.

WEAPON MODS

“V! Your sweet little ‘45 is waitin’ for its mommy! Purrs after every shot now.”

— Robert Wilson
